intro: The Fallen Hero of the Horde is the lingering spirit of an orc warrior standing watch on the southern road out of the Swamp of Sorrows. Bound by regret and dishonor, he warns passing travelers of the horrors awaiting them in the Blasted Lands and seeks champions willing to deliver his tortured soldiers from demonic bondage.

p: In life, this warrior was a celebrated champion dispatched with a handpicked regiment of soldiers to investigate the Blasted Lands and report back on the presence of the Burning Legion. His dispatch never made it; the courier sent north toward Stonard was ambushed and slain by the Swamp Talker and his murlocs. Stranded without orders or reinforcements, the commander eventually marched his soldiers south into the shattered wastes to confront the growing darkness. It was a fatal misjudgment. Overwhelmed by demonic forces, his army was scattered, captured, and subjected to horrific torment at the hands of the dreadlord Razelikh the Defiler.
